name: Fugu Ultra v2
title: Fugu Ultra v2: price, context window and specs
answer: Fugu Ultra v2 is a model in Sakana's Sakana Fugu family, first listed on 2026-09-11. It takes text, image and file in and returns text, with a context window of 1 million tokens and up to 128K tokens of output. On the lowest-cost route in the OpenRouter catalog it costs $5 per million input tokens and $30 per million output tokens. It supports a reasoning mode, where the model works through a problem before it answers. Its weights are not published, so it is reached through an API. Its training data runs to 2026-08-28.
compare: It is the newest of the 3 versions of Sakana Fugu listed today.
Its input price is the family median, $5 per million tokens.
No version in the family has a larger context window.
